g:HTMLPanel.p: Small overlays with a title and content: wrap a widget in a Popover.

d:Example.heading: Placement
d:Example.description: `title` and `content` fill the popover; `placement` sets the side. The default `trigger` is `HOVER`; these use `CLICK`.

d:Example.heading: Dismiss on the next click
d:Example.description: `trigger="FOCUS"` closes the popover when the user clicks anywhere else.

d:Example.heading: Events
d:Example.description: `addShownHandler` and `addHiddenHandler` run when the popover has opened or closed; `setContent` changes its text.
